name: Mariana E Valenzuela

bio.statement: Forest Grove's elections page lists Council President Mariana Valenzuela's seat as up for election in November 2026.
Valenzuela's pamphlet statement lists service on the Forest Grove City Council since 2020.
Valenzuela's pamphlet statement lists an MBA from Pacific University and degrees from New Mexico State University.
bio.excerpt: Pacific University, MBA; New Mexico State University, BA & MA.

bio.statement: Valenzuela's pamphlet statement lists prior work with Centro Cultural of Washington County and several colleges.
bio.excerpt: Centro Cultural of Washington County; Portland Community College; Clark College; Idaho State University

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Valenzuela says she seeks a full term to keep advocating for youth and elderly residents.
positions.excerpt: I am seeking a full term to have the opportunity to continue advocating on behalf of our youth, our elderly,

positions.statement: Valenzuela's pamphlet statement cites ensuring the well-being and security of all residents.
positions.excerpt: ensuring the well-being and security of all our residents.

positions.statement: Valenzuela's pamphlet statement says Forest Grove is well positioned to continue to grow and thrive.
positions.excerpt: I believe Forest Grove is well positioned to continue to grow and thrive in the coming years.
